chapter: Teddy Wilson, Cafe Society and bebop
title: Adjusting to swing and Teddy Wilson's style
summary: Moving from Chicago-era music to New York swing was a problem; Wilson's band was too good to last.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Now, in the meantime, swing music has sort of taken over --
-- and that was -- no, you were into New Orleans type of music before, so that was no problem, was it, was it just a natural transition?
Well, it was a problem, yes.
Because it was sort of new to me, because the time with Sam, I -- was a gap inbetween what I had been doing from the Chicago era until -- then jumping back into New York at that time.
With Teddy Wilson -- Teddy Wilson just had something altogether different from any band at that time. Style of swing.
And jazz. He had a great band, it was too great, it was too good. That's why it didn't last. It was just too good.
